gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-roboto-condensed: Expressive and loud, Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet. Roboto Condensed is the quiet counterweight, a sans-serif whose tight, wire-smooth lines glide along while the heading does the shouting.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-saira-semi-conde: Snowburst One looks like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges between its tall letters. And Saira Semi Condensed keeps its sans text looking enlarged, with bowls that never swell, so the heading's drama stays on top.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-secular-one: Wide stencil bridges mark Snowburst One at a glance. Make that heading small and the cut-out character fades, while Secular One, hollow as glass tubing in a constant line, holds up fine even when the sans text grows large.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-smooch-sans: Bold and expressive up top, Snowburst One sets a stencil tone. Smooch Sans then packs a sans line tightly, its high midline and open s keeping a long stretch of text moving without a snag.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-sofia-sans-conde: Sofia Sans Condensed reads friendly and upright, with round bowls of unvarying outline. Give it generous size, since its big x-height and tight ascender room are what carry the sans-serif text, leaving Snowburst One's stencil heading to stand apart.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-spline-sans-mono: Stencil bridges between tall letters are what Snowburst One is about. Yet Spline Sans Mono does the opposite job, a fixed-width monospace whose bold, uniform strokes and near-capital lowercase hold steady where the heading flares.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-tiny5: Snowburst One brings a stencil-cut swagger, its openings as wide as a sprung paper clip. Tiny5 takes the other job, a sans-serif so tall that its ascenders look short, built for plain, tidy text.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-truculenta: Crowded, compact and cheerful. Truculenta is a sans with short ascenders and rounded forms drawn like one nib, while Snowburst One handles the stencil-cut showmanship in the heading.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-ubuntu: Snowburst One arrives as a bold stencil sheet, tall in the lowercase and wide between letters. Ubuntu follows as a sans with its own lofty lowercase band, so heading and text share a height while differing in attitude.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-victor-mono: Snowburst One's stencil bridges and sprung-clip openings make it instantly recognizable, a heading with a bold, cut-paper manner. Victor Mono, a monospace, matches that boldness with structure instead.
